title: Assess the actual packed CLI before release
actor: A maintainer reviewing the candidate users would install
goal: Determine whether the exact packed CLI is complete and works at its declared clean-consumer boundary.
context: Source tests have run, but those observations do not establish the contents or behavior of the emitted package.
trigger: The maintainer selects the actual CLI artifact and corresponding target archives for qualification.
preconditions: The candidate package, selected archives, trusted metadata, and applicable package policy are identifiable.

interaction.action: Requests assessment of the exact emitted package and its supported installed-consumer behavior.
Reports actual member, executable, metadata, dependency, and clean-consumer observations with their artifact identities.
Reviews successful, unsuccessful, and unassessed package obligations against that candidate.

expected_outcome: The assessment establishes what the actual candidate supports and exposes defects or missing proof without treating the source checkout or a dry-run as equivalent evidence.

alternatives.condition: A forbidden member, missing runtime resource, or broken packed executable is observed.
alternatives.outcome: The candidate is reported unqualified with the actual defect and scope.

alternatives.condition: A required packed installation conflict or safety case fails.
alternatives.outcome: The composed product remains unqualified even if isolated builders or helpers passed.

failures.condition: The actual tarball, trusted archive inputs, or required clean-consumer observations cannot be obtained.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the unassessed boundary and cannot complete qualification.

failures.condition: A summary substitutes source-tree checks for actual package observations.
failures.outcome: The mismatch is exposed and the qualification claim cannot be relied on.
